name: Perfect Dark
description:
Perfect Dark (PC Port) is a native PC port of Rare's acclaimed 2000 Nintendo 64 first-person shooter Perfect Dark. Built from the decompilation of the original ROM, it brings Joanna Dark's sci-fi espionage adventure natively to PC.

Features:
- Native execution eliminating emulation latency and providing silky-smooth 60+ FPS gameplay
- True widescreen, ultrawide, and high-resolution rendering
- Modern first-person shooter controls supporting keyboard, mouse-look, and dual-analog gamepads
- Enhanced visual fidelity with customizable field of view and texture filtering
- Complete preservation of single-player missions, Combat Simulator multiplayer, and co-op modes
